name: Purple Line extension: Mysuru Road – Challaghatta
scope: 8.81 km western extension of the Purple Line, part of Namma Metro Phase 2
notes: Opened in two sections: Mysuru Road–Kengeri (2021-08) and Kengeri–Challaghatta (2023-10), per The Metro Rail Guy. A separately-reported ₹1,867.95 cr figure (Deccan Herald) could not be directly verified in this collection pass and remains withheld. The two civil-works contract values now on file (₹327 cr + ₹332 cr = ₹659 cr, confirmed directly from a Metro Rail News article dated 2021-06-28) are package-level construction contracts, not a confirmed total project cost — the ₹1,867.95 cr figure may cover land acquisition, systems and other components on top of these two packages, but that has not been confirmed.
